Meta.title: Verba — Practice writing in English
Meta.description: Pick a prompt, write in English and get your text back corrected, with the reason for every mistake.

Hero.title: Practice writing English, corrected sentence by sentence
Hero.subtitle: Pick a prompt, write a few paragraphs and get your text back corrected, with the reason for each mistake so you don't repeat it.
Hero.note: Sign in once with your Google account. No password to remember.

Demo.label: An example of a corrected text
Demo.prompt: Prompt: Tell us about your weekend
Demo.comment: Almost there! Watch your past simple.

HowItWorks.title: From prompt to corrected text in three steps
HowItWorks.step1Body: Choose a topic and length that suit your level, from a short email to a full paragraph.
HowItWorks.step2Body: Write freely, it doesn't have to be perfect. Your text is saved so you can continue later.
HowItWorks.step3Body: See each mistake, the reason and the fix, then rewrite a better version.

Features.title: Corrections that help you understand, not just fix
Features.grammarBody: Every mistake is marked, with why it is wrong and how to fix it.
Features.naturalBody: Correct but stiff? See other ways native speakers say the same thing.
Features.levelBody: From a short email to arguing a point in a paragraph, getting harder as you improve.
Features.memoryBody: Repeated mistakes are tracked so you know what to practise next.

Cta.title: Write your first sentence today
Cta.body: Signing in takes a few seconds. We use your Google name, email and profile photo to create your account.

Login.intro: Sign in to save your writing and track your progress.
Login.googleNote: We only use your Google name, email and profile photo to create your account.
Login.brandLine: One sentence a day and your writing will visibly improve.
